title: Botswana's Okavango Delta floods in the dry season
body: The Okavango River spreads across an inland delta in Botswana instead of reaching the sea. Floodwater arrives during Botswana's dry season, partly because it has travelled downstream from rains farther north.
takeaway: For local wildlife, the calendar of water can differ from the calendar of rain.
source: UNESCO World Heritage Centre, Okavango Delta (2014)

title: Colombia's Chiribiquete has flat-topped mountains above the forest
body: In Chiribiquete National Park, sheer-sided sandstone plateaux rise from the northwestern Amazon. These table mountains, called tepuis, stand where four major regions of plants and animals meet.
takeaway: A flat summit can be ecologically isolated from the forest at its foot even when both appear together on a map.
source: UNESCO World Heritage Centre, Chiribiquete National Park (2018)
visual: a sheer sandstone plateau rising above a continuous rainforest canopy
